description:
Is Seventh Day Adventism a Cult?

Seventh Day Adventists are known for the doctrine that is in their name, keeping the Sabbath (the seventh day). The real, distinctive doctrine of the SDA church is something called “The Investigative Judgment.”  We will look carefully at that doctrine in this video.

Chapters
0:00 - Intro
0:55 - Statistics and history of SDA
1:48 - Where the SDA came from 
2:49 - Hiram Edson's vision 
4:39 - Timeline of SDA history 
5:24 - 6 SDA doctrines that are similar to evangelical Christian doctrine
7:20 - 5 SDA doctrine that is different from evangelical Christianity
12:02 - Investigative Judgement debunked 
16:20 - The three particular aspects of our lives that will be judged
17:24 - Seventh-day Adventism is not a non-Christian cult 
18:58 - Final thoughts
